instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a wide, eye-level shot capturing an indoor motion capture studio with white walls and a red carpet. On the left, the bearded man in a black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, reaching out to touch the right shoulder of the woman in a white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2), who stands on the right facing left. The two are positioned in the center of the room, surrounded by background equipment like a white radiator and camera stands. The overhead indoor lighting casts soft shadows on the red carpet, creating a neutral, functional atmosphere.
